answer: Give newcomers a terraced climb where each step must echo the last. Trigger: an agent applies for paid work and locks a 4,850 POA terrace bond, starting on the lowest step. Rule: to climb one terrace it must re-perform a random past job live, and the replay must echo its original delivery in substance while differing in wording; a failed replay, or two identities replaying identically, burns the bond and bars both for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 485,000 POA. Honest agents climb one step at a time, and only an ivory-clean record reaches the top terrace.
